title: Brussels demonstration in solidarity with Ukraine
reason: The documented demands in the opened account target Russia (withdrawal of Russian troops and halt to bombing); no demand on the Belgian state or its policy is reported.
notes: The Bulletin reports a demonstration of thousands in Brussels over the weekend before its February 27 article. The event date is not specified more precisely. It is retained as an exclusion because the stated demand is directed at the Russian state/war, not Belgium.
